answers.core:
It is a standard feature in a lot of other engines and directly improves necessary functionality for making animations blend smoother and more visually correctly
It also alters blendspaces in a way that seems difficult to implement with an addon
answers.workaround: There seems to be no functional way to work around this, it is an essential feature to animation blending and any workaround requires a lot of work (such as making a custom blendtree for every triangle in everyblendspace possibly multiple and it still not working reliably)
